title: Everyday Phrases — Packing a School Lunchbox
title_quote: Let us plan the lunch box tonight.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🍱 實用「帶便當」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Packing a School Lunchbox
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「帶便當」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景從昨晚想好菜色開始：煮蛋、切水果、捏飯糰、把分格填好別壓爛、寫一張小紙條、放進保冷袋與保冷劑，早上才發現備用的紅筷子盒塞不進袋子，一路追到門口才交到他手上，最後孩子回家說便當最好吃，還決定多替沒便當的同學裝一盒。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含規劃菜單、擺便當盒、保冷與餐具、跟孩子聊天。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Packing a School Lunchbox' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene starts with planning the menu the night before: boiling eggs, cutting fruit, shaping rice balls, filling the compartments without crushing anything, writing a little note, packing the cooler bag with ice packs, hunting for the missing chopstick case, which will not fit in the bag and has to be run out to the gate, and hearing that the lunch box was the best one ever. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us plan the lunch box tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs plæn ðə lʌntʃ bɑks təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚來把便當想好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we need the empty box first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd wi nid ði ˈɛmpti bɑks fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 好，先把空便當盒拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dishes does he like the most?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈdɪʃɪz dʌz hi laɪk ðə moʊst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cucumber and egg always disappear first.
dialogue.zh: 小黃瓜和雞蛋總是最早被吃光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we buy the small cucumbers tomorrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi baɪ ðə smɔl ˈkjumˌʌmbɚz təˈmɑroʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fridge has two, enough for Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frɪdʒ hæz tu ɪˈnʌf fɚ ˈθɜrzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱還有兩條，夠週四用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write the menu on our white board.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈmɛnju ɑn ɑr waɪt bɔrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice balls, corn, and one boiled egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs bɔlz kɔrn ænd wʌn bɔɪld ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 飯糰、玉米，還有一顆水煮蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corn is sweet and fits the divider.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔrn ɪz swit ænd fɪts ðə dɪˈvaɪdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 玉米甜甜的，正好放進分格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the box has three sections only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðə bɑks hæz θri ˈsɛkʃənz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 小心，便當盒只有三個分格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three sections keep the rice dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry rice matters for the whole box.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ raɪs ˈmætɚz fɚ ðə hoʊl bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 飯要乾，整個便當才好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the tomato slices?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip the tomato this time, it leaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ ðɪs taɪm ɪt liks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a little carrot cup for him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə ˈlɪtəl ˈkærət kʌp fɚ hɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那就給他一小杯胡蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He eats carrots only when we cut stars.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi its ˈkærətz ˈoʊnli wɛn wi kʌt stɑrz/
dialogue.zh: 他只吃切成星星的胡蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stars take time, but the box looks cute.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrz teɪk taɪm bʌt ðə bɑks lʊks kjut/
dialogue.zh: 壓星星花時間，但便當可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will find the small star cutter.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl faɪnd ðə smɔl stɑr ˈkʌtɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cutter lives in the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom drawer, next to the chopstick case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm drɔər nɛkst tə ðə ˈtʃɑpstɪk keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 最下面那格，在筷子組旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His chopstick case is blue, right?
dialogue.zh: 他的筷子盒是藍色的對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue with a seal, we bought it last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu wɪð ə sil wi bɔt ɪt læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 藍色有密封條那組，上個月買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we wash it after Sunday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, it waits in the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt ɪt weɪts ɪn ðə sɪŋk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sink is full of dishes again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɪŋk ɪz fʊl əv ˈdɪʃɪz əˈɡɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us rinse the sink now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在先沖一沖水槽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: School lunch is off on Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So Friday needs a bigger lunch box.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈfraɪdeɪ nidz ə ˈbɪɡɚ lʌntʃ bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 所以禮拜五要更大的便當盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday also has swimming, my love.
dialogue.zh: 星期五還有游泳課，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a dry snack fits the swim bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə draɪ snæk fɪts ðə swɪm bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 那帶個乾點心放進游泳袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks belong in the small blue box.
dialogue.phonetic: /snæks bɪˈlɔŋ ɪn ðə smɔl blu bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 點心要放那個藍色小盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the snack box keeps the crumbs away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə snæk bɑks kips ðə krʌmz əˈweɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What drink goes with the lunch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk, we freeze one carton overnight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frozen milk stays cold in class.
dialogue.zh: 凍牛奶到上課還是涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By noon it is cool enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He asked for a peanut butter roll.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æskt fɚ ə ˈpinʌt ˈbʌtɚ roʊl/
dialogue.zh: 他上次想要花生醬蛋捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, but the box gets sticky fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn bʌt ðə bɑks ɡɛts ˈstɪki fæst/
dialogue.zh: 好，可是便當盒很容易變黏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We line it with plastic wrap then.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi laɪn ɪt wɪð ˈplæstɪk ræp ðɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the wrap sits under the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə ræp sɪts ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any leftovers for the lunch box?
dialogue.zh: 昨天的菜能剩一點進便當嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chicken breast, we slice it thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃɪkən brɛst wi slaɪs ɪt θɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin slices warm up faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them at the edge of the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm æt ði ɛdʒ əv ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 把它們擺在便當盒邊緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he want sausage or the ham?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi wɑnt ˈsɔsɪdʒ ɔr ði hæm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sausage, cut in little rings for him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔsɪdʒ kʌt ɪn ˈlɪtəl rɪŋz fɚ hɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rings or flowers, he calls them toys.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋz ɔr ˈflaʊɚz hi kɔlz ðɛm tɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 圓圈或花朵，他說那是玩具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then toy shapes in the second section.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɔɪ ʃeɪps ɪn ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈsɛkʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The menu looks full already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take out the kiwi, keep the apple.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk aʊt ðə ˈkiwi kip ði ˈæpəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Apples turn brown in the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt water holds the color back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half a teaspoon of salt, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə ˈtispun əv sɔlt noʊ mɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough to soak two apple slices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the little sauce cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside the lid, with the paper liners.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə lɪd wɪð ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈlaɪnɚz/
dialogue.zh: 在蓋子裡，跟紙墊放一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper liners look like tiny cups.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for sauce, for the dip too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɚ sɔs fɚ ðə dɪp tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He needs protein in every box.
dialogue.zh: 每個便當都要有蛋白質。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Egg tonight, chicken in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 晚上先煮蛋，早上再切雞胸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eggs boil in ten minutes here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the timer, the small round one.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə ˈtaɪmɚ ðə smɔl raʊnd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 設定時器，那個圓圓小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Timer is right beside the stove.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, and the pot needs water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ænd ðə pɑt nidz ˈwɔtɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold water, so the shells come off.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtɚ soʊ ðə ʃɛlz kʌm ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off easily, or we lose the white.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔf ˈizəli ɔr wi luz ði waɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要好剝，不然蛋白會跟著掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pot sits on the back burner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɑt sɪts ɑn ðə bæk ˈbɜrnɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front one is for the eggs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði frʌnt wʌn ɪz fɚ ði ɛɡz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rice for the balls, one full cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs fɚ ðə bɔlz wʌn fʊl kʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, he shares with his friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps hi ʃɛrz wɪð hɪz frɛnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His friend likes the seaweed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then cut the seaweed into long strips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌt ðə ˈsiˌwid ˈɪntu lɔŋ strɪps/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long strips wrap the rice balls.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrapping keeps the whole box neat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many balls fit the middle section?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni bɔlz fɪt ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈsɛkʃən/
dialogue.zh: 中間那格放得下幾個飯糰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three small ones, never four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four will crush the soft corn.
dialogue.zh: 四個會壓到軟軟的玉米。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then corn goes in the tall cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kɔrn ɡoʊz ɪn ðə tɔl kʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tall cup leaks, remember Monday?
dialogue.zh: 高杯會漏，還記得週一嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, we seal it with the rubber ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wi sil ɪt wɪð ðə ˈrʌbɚ rɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rubber ring, lid, and the clip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All three must click before we leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl θri mʌst klɪk bɪˈfɔr wi liv/
dialogue.zh: 三樣都要扣好才能出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click the clips, not the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, the lid is thin plastic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything for the green section?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Broccoli trees, two small crowns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broccoli needs a hot water bath.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty seconds, then cold water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green stays green that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the box should look like a garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə bɑks ʃʊd lʊk laɪk ə ˈɡɑrdən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A garden box makes him smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smile, then he eats the carrot too.
dialogue.phonetic: /smaɪl ðɛn hi its ðə ˈkærət tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write the grocery list, my dear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two eggs, seaweed, and one banana.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bananas turn black in the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then skip the banana, buy more grapes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn skɪp ðə bəˈnænə baɪ mɔr ɡreɪps/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grapes need cutting in halves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halves, and I wipe each one dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /hævz ænd aɪ waɪp itʃ wʌn draɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry fruit, that is the rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rule of the lunch box, agreed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen is bright this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright, and the lunch box waits open.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt ænd ðə lʌntʃ bɑks weɪts ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 便當盒開著蓋子等在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four eggs into the small pot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four? two for the box, two for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr tu fɚ ðə bɑks tu fɚ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 四顆？兩顆進便當，兩顆我們吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with cold water, remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water, then the burner on low.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɔtɚ ðɛn ðə ˈbɜrnɚ ɑn loʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low heat keeps the shells from cracking.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ hit kips ðə ʃɛlz frʌm ˈkrækɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set the timer for nine minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt ðə ˈtaɪmɚ fɚ naɪn ˈmɪnɪts/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine gives a soft yellow center.
dialogue.zh: 九分鐘的蛋心是嫩黃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft it is, but he likes firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft ɪt ɪz bʌt hi laɪks fɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 軟的呀，不過他愛熟一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Firm eggs, then we boil two more.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm ɛɡz ðɛn wi bɔɪl tu mɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six eggs, the box takes only two.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɛɡz ðə bɑks teɪks ˈoʊnli tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While the eggs boil, wash the fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl ði ɛɡz bɔɪl wɑʃ ðə frut/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grapes first, they hide the dust.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse them under the tap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool water, and rub each grape.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now dry the grapes on a towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ draɪ ðə ɡreɪps ɑn ə ˈtaʊəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry grapes, or the rice gets wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ɡreɪps ɔr ðə raɪs ɡɛts wɛt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cutting board is clean already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the green side for the fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ɡrin saɪd fɚ ðə frut/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green side, and the knife is sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin saɪd ænd ðə naɪf ɪz ʃɑrp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharp means slow, my dear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slice the apple in even rounds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rounds, then four small pieces each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four pieces fit the fruit section.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too high, the lid must close.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt tu haɪ ðə lɪd mʌst kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 別堆太高，蓋子要關得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lid presses the tall pieces.
dialogue.zh: 蓋子一壓，高的那塊會扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I cut the apple flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat slices, and the salt water bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ˈslaɪsɪz ænd ðə sɔlt ˈwɔtɚ boʊl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bowl is ready, soak them two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊl ɪz ˈrɛdi soʊk ðɛm tu ˈmɪnɪts/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, then lift them out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift them with the small fork, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðɛm wɪð ðə smɔl fɔrk jɛs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kiwi for the last gap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kiwi is sour, he hates sour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then one orange slice, just one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One slice, no juice on the rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn slaɪs noʊ dʒus ɑn ðə raɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Juice stains the whole paper liner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I add a liner, we have ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æd ə ˈlaɪnɚ wi hæv tɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The eggs are done, I hear the timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛɡz ɑr dʌn aɪ hɪr ðə ˈtaɪmɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off the heat, into cold water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold bath stops the cooking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll the shell on the counter first.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl ðə ʃɛl ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先在流理台上把殼滾鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Roll gently, tap the wide end.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel it under running water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peel slowly, keep the egg whole.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whole eggs look neat in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl ɛɡz lʊk nit ɪn ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 完整的蛋擺進便當才好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one cracked, we eat it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn krækt wi it ɪt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cracked or not, it tastes fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slice the good egg in halves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halves show the yellow rings.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The egg halves sit in the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛɡ hævz sɪt ɪn ðə ˈkɔrnɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Corner, so they touch no rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Egg yolk crumbs on the rice, no.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡ joʊk krʌmz ɑn ðə raɪs noʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the yolk with the spoon edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə joʊk wɪð ðə spun ɛdʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Egg white on the lid again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it, then close the box tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt ðɛn kloʊz ðə bɑks taɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you cut the strawberries?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut in two, laid flat on the liner.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt ɪn tu leɪd flæt ɑn ðə ˈlaɪnɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Berries stain the divider badly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the berries stay in their own cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈbɛriz steɪ ɪn ðɛr oʊn kʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their own cup, yes, the clear one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr oʊn kʌp jɛs ði klɪr wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear cups show the fruit colors.
dialogue.zh: 透明杯看得到水果顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Colors matter more than taste.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For him, yes, red makes it fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ hɪm jɛs rɛd meɪks ɪt fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 對他來說是，紅色比較好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fun food gets eaten faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster, and he brings the box home clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstɚ ænd hi brɪŋz ðə bɑks hoʊm klin/
dialogue.zh: 吃得快，便當盒也空著回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean box, that is the goal.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The apple is done, next the corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈæpəl ɪz dʌn nɛkst ðə kɔrn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corn kernels fall everywhere here.
dialogue.zh: 剝玉米粒在這裡會亂飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the cob over the bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Over the bowl, clever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever only in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning is short, we know it.
dialogue.zh: 早上的時間很短，我們知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the fruit goes first today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hands washed, the fruit touches skin.
dialogue.zh: 手洗了嗎？水果會碰到皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Washed with soap, twice already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soap leaves a smell in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊp livz ə smɛl ɪn ðə bɑks/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse well, the fruit stays sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet melon for the weekend box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Melon waters too much, skip it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pineapple then, tiny triangles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny triangles, the star cutter again?
dialogue.zh: 小三角，又要用星星模具？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, stars and triangles both.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both shapes fit the second row.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second row holds the rice balls.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛkənd roʊ hoʊldz ðə raɪs bɔlz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice balls come next, wait for them.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs bɔlz kʌm nɛkst weɪt fɚ ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the eggs still steam.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam makes the lid fog up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fog means water inside the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we cool each egg completely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Completely cool, then into the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner, not near the rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit knife or big knife?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit knife, the small red handle.
dialogue.zh: 水果刀，紅色小手柄那把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The small red handle, got it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the blade after every cut.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe, and the board gets turned over.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ænd ðə bɔrd ɡɛts tɜrnd ˈoʊvɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turned over for the egg slices.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit done, the section looks full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full and pretty, now the rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rice cooker is still warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm rice packs better in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm raɪs pæks ˈbɛtɚ ɪn ðə bɑks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fluff it once with the paddle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Once, no more, then a pinch of salt.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns noʊ mɔr ðɛn ə pɪntʃ əv sɔlt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salt on the rice, not on the fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt ɑn ðə raɪs nɑt ɑn ðə frut/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted, the fruit stays plain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet your hands so nothing sticks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water in the bowl beside the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ ɪn ðə boʊl bɪˈsaɪd ðə bɑks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A handful of rice, press it lightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhændˌfʊl əv raɪs prɛs ɪt ˈlaɪtli/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lightly, or the ball turns hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hard rice balls feel like stones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft ones, he can bite them easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft wʌnz hi kən baɪt ðɛm ˈizi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shape it into a small triangle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Triangle, circle, square, three shapes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three shapes for three sections.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice match, keep the sizes even.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even sizes, even eating time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He eats the small one first, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi its ðə smɔl wʌn fɜrst ˈɔlweɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the ham inside the rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ham in the middle, hidden well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hidden fillings make him dig.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dig, find, smile, three steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheese in the second ball?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheese melts and ruins the seaweed.
dialogue.zh: 起司會融化，海苔就爛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then no cheese, plain rice there.
dialogue.zh: 那這格不放起司，就白飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain rice shows the egg color.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the ball with one seaweed strip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðə bɔl wɪð wʌn ˈsiˌwid strɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One strip, shiny side out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shiny out, the box looks green.
dialogue.zh: 亮面朝外，便當看起來翠綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green seaweed, then the salt on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ˈsiˌwid ðɛn ðə sɔlt ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 海苔綠，最上面再灑點鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tiny pinch of sesame too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sesame falls into every section.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only two grains, right on the ball.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu ɡreɪnz raɪt ɑn ðə bɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two grains, agreed, very neat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the plastic wrap needed here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap helps the rice keep shape.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the wrap tight around it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight, but do not press the corn.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt bʌt du nɑt prɛs ðə kɔrn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corn lives in its own cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Its own cup, its own little house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts oʊn kʌp ɪts oʊn ˈlɪtəl haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 自己的杯子，自己的小房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A house per item, funny rule.
dialogue.zh: 每樣食物一間房子，有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny, but nothing mixes now.
dialogue.zh: 有趣，但現在什麼都不混。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second ball needs a bigger handful.
dialogue.zh: 第二個飯糰要多抓一點飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bigger for him, smaller for the friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪɡɚ fɚ hɪm ˈsmɔlər fɚ ðə frɛnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The friend gets one plain ball.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain, no ham, no sesame.
dialogue.zh: 素的，不放火腿也不放芝麻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No ham, because his friend is vegetarian?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hæm bɪˈkɔz hɪz frɛnd ɪz ˌvɛdʒəˈtɛriən/
dialogue.zh: 不放火腿，是因為他同學吃素？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch, we keep beans instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beans in the third ball then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third ball, red beans, sweet a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd bɔl rɛd binz swit ə bɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet rice and salt rice together?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep the sweet one separate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Separate balls, separate flavors.
dialogue.zh: 分開的飯糰，分開的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flavors travel in a closed box.
dialogue.zh: 味道會在密閉盒子裡跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the lid stays on tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight lid, and no smell in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt lɪd ænd noʊ smɛl ɪn ðə bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are full of rice now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl əv raɪs naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse your hands, then dry them well.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns jɔr hændz ðɛn draɪ ðɛm wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 去把手沖乾淨，再用毛巾擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three balls done, count again.
dialogue.zh: 三個飯糰好了，再數一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, and one spare.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A spare for the lunch break.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spare ball, no seaweed on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Without seaweed it dries faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap it then, quick plastic cover.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quick cover, then the spoon rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spoon rest, we use the paper napkin.
dialogue.phonetic: /spun rɛst wi juz ðə ˈpeɪpɚ ˈnæpkɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The napkin folds under the ball.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Folded napkin soaks up water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the rice stays dry under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə raɪs steɪz draɪ ˈʌndɚ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很好，飯在下面就不會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry rice, soft ball, happy eater.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Happy eater means a quiet class.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet class, yes, no food trading.
dialogue.zh: 安靜的教室，也不交換食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Food trading, he trades all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything, so we label each ball.
dialogue.zh: 什麼都換，所以每個飯糰做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mark with the seaweed scrap.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrap letters, his name in dots.
dialogue.zh: 海苔碎拼字母，點出名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dots for his name, clever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever and fast, two seconds each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seconds for three balls.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six seconds total, we have time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time enough for the egg halves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Egg halves go beside the balls.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beside, not under the rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under pressure, the yolk breaks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broken yolk in the rice, no.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never too late, we learned that Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ tu leɪt wi lɜrnd ðæt ˈtuzdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday he ate white rice only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only rice, and one sad cucumber.
dialogue.zh: 只有飯加一根難過的小黃瓜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sad cucumber, poor vegetable.
dialogue.zh: 傷心的小黃瓜，可憐的蔬菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheer it up with the star shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃir ɪt ʌp wɪð ðə stɑr ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 用星星形狀讓它開心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stars on the cucumber, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press gently, cucumbers crack quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quick cracks, then water leaks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the divider gets slippery.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slippery boxes slide off the table.
dialogue.zh: 滑滑的便當會從桌上滑下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off the table, onto the kitchen floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑf ðə ˈteɪbəl ˈɑntu ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn flɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor meal, never again.
dialogue.zh: 掉在地上那一餐，再也不來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, we dry the divider twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice dry, then the rice balls.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice balls in, the middle section closes.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs bɔlz ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈsɛkʃən ˈkloʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 飯糰放好，中間那格滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Order matters in the lunch box.
dialogue.zh: 便當的擺放順序有講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy first, light on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy items press the soft fruit.
dialogue.zh: 重的東西會壓到軟水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the apple slices stay last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last in, top of the stack.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack means risk in his bag.
dialogue.zh: 疊起來在他書包裡就有風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His bag flips sometimes, we know.
dialogue.zh: 他的書包有時翻倒，我們知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then every layer needs support.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The divider gives that support.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Divider clips in, no tape needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tape, the clip is plastic.
dialogue.zh: 不用膠帶，卡扣是塑膠的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plastic clips break in hot sun.
dialogue.zh: 塑膠扣在大太陽下會斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot sun, the bus stop is bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt sʌn ðə bʌs stɑp ɪz braɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright and warm, so the cooler bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt ænd wɔrm soʊ ðə ˈkulɚ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 又亮又熱，所以要用保冷袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooler bag later, now the packing.
dialogue.zh: 保冷袋等一下，先擺便當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Packing now, the sections are open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Section one holds the rice balls.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Section two, the egg and corn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Section three is the fruit home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three homes, three little meals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lettuce leaves under the corn.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lettuce cushions, like a pillow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A green pillow, clever again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, and the corn stays tall.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，玉米也不會被壓扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall corn and pressed corn, big difference.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔl kɔrn ænd prɛst kɔrn bɪɡ ˈdɪfərəns/
dialogue.zh: 挺立的玉米和壓扁的差很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can tell, sadly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell by color, or by shape?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By shape, crushed corn looks pale.
dialogue.zh: 看形狀，壓過的玉米發白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pale food, no appetite.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So protect every yellow thing.
dialogue.zh: 所以要保護所有黃色的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yellow things get the soft bed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft bed, no heavy lid press.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the lid touch the rice?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, the rice sits low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low rice, high fruit, balanced.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Balanced boxes close with a click.
dialogue.zh: 擺平衡的便當一聲卡扣就關上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That click, my favorite sound.
dialogue.zh: 那聲卡扣是我最愛的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Favorite? mine is the shake test.
dialogue.zh: 最愛？我喜歡搖一搖測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake the box, listen inside.
dialogue.zh: 搖搖盒子，聽裡面的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud sliding means too much room.
dialogue.zh: 大聲滑動代表空格太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much room, so the food moves.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ rum soʊ ðə fud muvz/
dialogue.zh: 空間太多，食物就會亂跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then fold a napkin as filler.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A napkin wedge, who knew.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who knew, but the corn stays put.
dialogue.phonetic: /hu nu bʌt ðə kɔrn steɪz pʊt/
dialogue.zh: 誰知道呢，玉米真的固定住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stays put, the sauce cup too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sauce cup needs its own lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɔs kʌp nidz ɪts oʊn lɪd/
dialogue.zh: 醬料杯要自己那個小蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its own lid, small blue one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue one fits, twist it tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twist, not press, the cup cracks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cracks leak soy on the rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soy on white rice, a map.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wet map, he will not eat it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɛt mæp hi wɪl nɑt it ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then double wrap the soy cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Double wrap, and place it upright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upright, the box stays flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat box, flat rice, flat day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A flat day sounds nice.
dialogue.zh: 平順的一天聽起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, and no wet napkin either.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，也不會出現濕紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet napkins come from cold water.
dialogue.zh: 濕紙巾是從冷凝水來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold water on the box outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside wet, inside dry, good.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the outside before the bag.
dialogue.zh: 放進袋子前把外面擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the bag, yes, noted.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noted on the little paper list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The list hangs by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the door, next to his shoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə dɔr nɛkst tə hɪz ʃuz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His shoes wait for school too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: School waits for no one, hurry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hurry, but the lid is upside down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɜri bʌt ðə lɪd ɪz ˌʌpˈsaɪd daʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Upside down, the clip will not catch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌpˈsaɪd daʊn ðə klɪp wɪl nɑt kætʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it, the logo faces up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Logo up, then press four corners.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four corners, one, two, three, four.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All four clicked, no gap left.
dialogue.zh: 四聲都扣上了，沒有縫隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No gap, but the box tilts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilts because the corn is heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy corn on the left side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left side, rice on the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left and right, now it sits level.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ænd raɪt naʊ ɪt sɪts ˈlɛvəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Level box, level lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything tall enough to poke?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cucumber rolls, round ends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round ends are safe, fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safe, but the fork is not.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fork stays in the case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the case, wrapped in cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloth keeps the metal quiet.
dialogue.zh: 布包讓金屬不敲出聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet metal, no noise in class.
dialogue.zh: 安靜的金屬，課堂上不會吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noise in class, he hates that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then cloth, and the soft napkin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soft napkin, the blue one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue pack, three sheets inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three sheets, one per section.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One per section, exactly our rule.
dialogue.zh: 一格一張，正是我們的規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our rule, our box, our morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our morning ends with the lid.
dialogue.zh: 我們的早晨以蓋上蓋子結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ends with the lid, not yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the fruit section waits.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fruit section, finally full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full box, no room for more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the little paper note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The note, his favorite part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut a square from the pad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squares, not circles, they fold flat.
dialogue.zh: 用方形不用圓形，才能摺平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold it once, thin and small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin notes hide under the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the lid, or on the rice?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə lɪd ɔr ɑn ðə raɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the lid, ink never touches food.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndɚ ðə lɪd ɪŋk ˈnɛvɚ ˈtʌtʃɪz fud/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子下面，油墨不會碰食物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point, ink smells strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then pencil, the soft round one.
dialogue.zh: 那用鉛筆，圓圓軟的那支。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soft pencil writes pale lines.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pale lines, he reads slowly anyway.
dialogue.zh: 淡淡的字，他本來就讀得慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow reading, that is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, five words are enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note says eat well, son.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five words, and that is plenty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did you write there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote that I love him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Love him, simple and clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear, and he shows no face.
dialogue.zh: 明白，可是他也不會表現什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No face, but he keeps the notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ feɪs bʌt hi kips ðə noʊts/
dialogue.zh: 沒表情，但他都留著紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keeps them in the pencil case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pencil case is full already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full of paper squares, tiny messages.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny messages from nine months.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine months, one shoe box of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn mʌnθs wʌn ʃu bɑks əv ðɛm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A shoe box of notes, wow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, we should number them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number them, save the dates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dates in the corner, small digits.
dialogue.zh: 日期在角落，數字小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small digits, big hearts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hearts draw fast with the red marker.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑrts drɔ fæst wɪð ði rɛd ˈmɑrkɚ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red marker, one heart only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one, else it looks noisy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noisy paper, quiet lunch box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet lunch, he reads it alone.
dialogue.zh: 安靜吃便當，他獨自看紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alone at his desk, sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, desks are not so quiet.
dialogue.zh: 是呀，課桌椅其實不安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not so quiet, but he reads.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reads, folds it, hides it again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hides it in the seaweed wrap?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, in the empty divider slot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The empty divider slot, clever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever spot, nothing touches it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing touches paper here?
dialogue.zh: 紙在這裡真的碰不到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam can wet the note.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wet notes ruin the pencil line.
dialogue.zh: 濕紙條會讓鉛筆字糊掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we cool the eggs first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool eggs, cool box, dry note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry note, that matters most.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we write words in English?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: English words, three easy ones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rice and apple and one egg.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he can read them now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read them aloud at lunch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aloud, with his friend beside him.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The friend likes the star hearts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Star hearts, we draw two notes.
dialogue.zh: 星星愛心，那我們寫兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two notes, one for the friend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for the friend, kind words.
dialogue.zh: 給同學那張，寫友善的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kind words like share and thank.
dialogue.zh: 友善的話像是分享、謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Share and thank, he will try.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try, and we write tomorrow too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow too, every school day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every school day, one note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One note per box, our habit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our habit since the first week.
dialogue.zh: 從第一週就開始的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First week, he could not read.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could not read, so we drew pictures.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd nɑt rid soʊ wi drju ˈpɪktʃɚz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pictures of smiley faces now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smiley faces, two eyes, one mouth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One mouth, a small line up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small line, and he smiles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smiles before the first bite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First bite, then the note again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again and again, five times.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five times, the paper gets soft.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft paper, still his favorite.
dialogue.zh: 軟軟的紙，仍是他的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Favorite thing in the box.
dialogue.zh: 便當裡他最喜歡的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The note beats the rice ball.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beats the rice ball, unbelievable.
dialogue.zh: 比飯糰還受歡迎，難以置信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Believable, he reads before eating.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reads before eating, a good habit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habit, clean hands too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean hands touch paper, not rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the note stays clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the note flat, no crease.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No crease, the square shape holds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holds the shape till noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By noon, even the corner is dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ nun ˈivən ðə ˈkɔrnɚ ɪz draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 到中午，連角落都是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry corner, warm lunch time.
dialogue.zh: 角落乾乾的，午餐時間暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lunch time, he opens the lid.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Opens the lid, finds the square.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finds it, pocket, then eats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pocket, not the trash bin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never the bin, he keeps them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keeps paper notes from us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From us, one small line daily.
dialogue.zh: 是我們每天的一行小字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small line, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all a box needs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cooler bag is ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready, with two ice packs inside.
dialogue.zh: 好了，裡面有兩包保冷劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ice packs freeze overnight flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat packs slide around the box.
dialogue.zh: 扁扁的保冷劑能沿便當滑動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around the box, not on the fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd ðə bɑks nɑt ɑn ðə frut/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit hates the cold directly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold fruit, no taste left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then a thin towel between them.
dialogue.zh: 那在中間墊一條薄毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A thin towel, the blue one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue towel, folded in halves.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In halves, then under the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the box, the cold rises.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rises slowly, the rice stays fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice is fine, but the cheese must stay cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs ɪz faɪn bʌt ðə tʃiz mʌst steɪ kul/
dialogue.zh: 飯還好，但起司要保持涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heat is the enemy at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enemy at noon, hence the bag.
dialogue.zh: 中午的敵人，所以要有保冷袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bag keeps the box cool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool until the long break.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long break, the last period.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last period, still cool inside.
dialogue.zh: 最後一節課裡面還是涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still cool, that is the test.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The test we pass every June.
dialogue.zh: 每年六月都通過的考驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: June is hot in our city.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot city, hot bus, hot bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot bag, cold box, opposite.
dialogue.zh: 袋子熱、盒子冷，兩個極端。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Opposite inside one small bag.
dialogue.zh: 相反的東西在同一個小袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bag, three pockets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pockets for the box, the drink, the note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɑkɪts fɚ ðə bɑks ðə drɪŋk ðə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 便當、飲料、紙條各有口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The drink pocket is silver inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Silver lining holds the cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold for the milk carton.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The carton stands in the corner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stands upright, like the sauce cup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the sauce cup, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, now the zipper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zipper slow, it catches cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Catches the blue towel edge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tuck it inside first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tucked, now close the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close it, hear that soft zip.
dialogue.zh: 關上，聽那輕輕的拉鏈聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft zip, the bag is closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed bag, one more check.
dialogue.zh: 袋子關了，還要再檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the name tag on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name tag, his full name.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full name and the class number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Class number in red marker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red marker, the same one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same one, the cap is tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tight caps keep markers alive.
dialogue.zh: 蓋緊筆蓋，彩色筆才不會乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alive and ready for the next note.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaɪv ænd ˈrɛdi fɚ ðə nɛkst noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 還濕潤，下一張紙條能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The next note, yes, back to the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst noʊt jɛs bæk tə ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 下一張紙條，好，回到袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bag goes into the backpack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Into the side pocket, not the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə saɪd ˈpɑkɪt nɑt ðə ˈmɪdəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side pocket, the box stays flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat in the pocket, no tilt.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tilt, no crushed corn again.
dialogue.zh: 不歪，玉米就不會再被壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crushed corn taught us that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taught well, we pack with care.
dialogue.zh: 教得好，我們以後小心擺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With care, and steady hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady hands, cold packs, done.
dialogue.zh: 手穩、保冷劑到位，就完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready? the lunch bag is not shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi ðə lʌntʃ bæɡ ɪz nɑt ʃʌt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shut it, then lift the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift it, feel the weight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy enough, full of care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Care plus ice packs plus rice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice plus egg plus four grapes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four grapes, that is the limit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Limit of the fruit pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pocket, bag, backpack, three layers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three layers keep the cold in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep in the cold, keep out heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪn ðə koʊld kip aʊt hit/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out stays the July sun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: July sun through the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Window light, keep the bag shaded.
dialogue.zh: 窗邊的光，袋子要避開曬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shaded spot near the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the door, where he grabs it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr ðə dɔr wɛr hi ɡræbz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 門口，他出門順手拿的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grabs it, then runs out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Runs out with the cool bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool bag on his small back.
dialogue.zh: 保冷袋在他小小的背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small back, heavy lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy lunch, light morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light morning, we still made it.
dialogue.zh: 早晨輕鬆，我們還是趕完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Made it, and nothing melted.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Melted cheese, never here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we plan, so nothing melts.
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡規畫，所以不會融化。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Melting needs hours, we have minutes.
dialogue.zh: 融化要好幾小時，我們只有幾分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Minutes count in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them, eleven left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven minutes, plenty for the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty, the bag takes two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes, and the rest?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rest is for your coffee.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coffee can wait today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, the lunch bag is more important.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə lʌntʃ bæɡ ɪz mɔr ɪmˈpɔrtənt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More important, yes, it feeds him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feeds him, and keeps him calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Calm until the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Afternoon, the box comes home empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty box, the best report.
dialogue.zh: 空盒子就是最好的報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best report, tomorrow we do it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst rɪˈpɔrt təˈmɑroʊ wi du ɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 最好的報告，明天再來一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chopstick case is missing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Missing? we packed it last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last night it sat on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst naɪt ɪt sæt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the table, beside the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beside the box, not beside the case.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈsaɪd ðə bɑks nɑt bɪˈsaɪd ðə keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 在便當旁，不在筷子盒旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the case never came here.
dialogue.zh: 那就是筷子盒根本沒來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never here, we must find it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Find it, we have six minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six minutes for the chopsticks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the second drawer again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The second drawer has forks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forks? he does not use forks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does not use forks, he says.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Says that, but eats with chopsticks.
dialogue.zh: 這樣說，但他用筷子吃得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chopsticks are in the blue case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue case, then the green spare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu keɪs ðɛn ðə ɡrin spɛr/
dialogue.zh: 藍色那盒，還有備用的綠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green spare? where is that?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hanging on the hook by the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæŋɪŋ ɑn ðə hʊk baɪ ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 掛在冰箱旁邊的鉤子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the fridge, or the shelf above.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə frɪdʒ ɔr ðə ʃɛlf əˈbʌv/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱旁，還是上面那層架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Above it, the lunch bag shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lunch bag shelf, yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, empty this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty shelf, empty hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands must hold the spare set.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spare set, hanging on the hook.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the hook, red this time.
dialogue.zh: 鉤子上那組，這次是紅色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Red set, small for kids.
dialogue.zh: 紅色那組，小孩用的小筷子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones grip the rice better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grip the rice, yes, quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quickly, the bag is open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open bag, red case will not fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən bæɡ rɛd keɪs wɪl nɑt fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 打開袋子，紅色筷子盒塞不進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not fit, so set it on the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɪt soʊ sɛt ɪt ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 塞不進，那就擱在流理台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The counter, not the bag then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not the bag, so nothing presses fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ðə bæɡ soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈprɛsɪz frut/
dialogue.zh: 不在袋子裡，就壓不到水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit stays clean, good news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good news, just in time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In time, the bus is coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coming, so he runs downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Downstairs with the cooler bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the bag, the lunch box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch box, did he check it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Checked at the door, I saw.
dialogue.zh: 在門口檢查過，我看到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saw it, then relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, the box travels well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Travel well, but he forgets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forgets the case at school.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At school, we lose one a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt skul wi luz wʌn ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 在學校，一個月弄丟一支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One a month, cheap but annoying.
dialogue.zh: 一個月一支，便宜但惱人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Annoying, so we write his name.
dialogue.zh: 惱人，所以寫上他的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name on the case, name on the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ɑn ðə keɪs neɪm ɑn ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 筷子盒寫名，便當盒也寫名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both named, nothing wanders.
dialogue.zh: 兩邊都有名字，就不會亂跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wanders anyway, ask Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 還是會亂跑，問週二那次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tuesday, the spoon came home alone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alone, without its twin.
dialogue.zh: 孤零零，沒有它的另一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twin spoons, one lost in class.
dialogue.zh: 一對湯勺，一支丟在班上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lost in the school drawer maybe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: School drawers swallow small things.
dialogue.zh: 學校抽屜會吃掉小東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swallow ours, keep the case shut.
dialogue.zh: 會吃掉我們的，所以要蓋好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shut the case, hear the click.
dialogue.zh: 關上筷子盒，聽到卡一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The click means the chopsticks stay.
dialogue.zh: 那聲卡代表筷子在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stay together, chopsticks and spoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Together in the cloth roll.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloth roll, napkin, then case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Case last, so nothing falls out.
dialogue.zh: 最後關盒，就不會掉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Falls out under the seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the seat of the bus.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the bus, no rescue then.
dialogue.zh: 在公車上就救不回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rescue, so we buy two sets.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈrɛsˌkjus soʊ wi baɪ tu sɛts/
dialogue.zh: 救不回來，所以我們買兩組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sets, one for rainy days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rainy days need a dry case.
dialogue.zh: 下雨天需要乾的筷子盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry case, wet umbrella outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside the door, with the shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With the shoes, all lined up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lined up, the bag and the lunch box.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪnd ʌp ðə bæɡ ænd ðə lʌntʃ bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 排好了，一個保冷袋、一個便當盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch box last, he grabs it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grabs it and the blue cap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue cap, backpack, out the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out the door, minus the case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Minus? I saw it right here.
dialogue.zh: 沒帶？我明明看到在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here? the counter holds it.
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡？流理台上還放著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holds it? but he is gone.
dialogue.zh: 還在台面上？人卻已經走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, up the street already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then run, take the red case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Running, with my slippers on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slippers, stop at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gate is open, I see him.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡeɪt ɪz ˈoʊpən aɪ si hɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call him, wave the case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He turns, he sees the red.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He runs back for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back, out of breath, laughing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Laughing, holding the red case.
dialogue.zh: 笑著，手裡拿著紅筷子盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside it, the napkin too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The napkin too, all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, off to school.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off to school with the case.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the case, without the worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worry now, learned today.
dialogue.zh: 現在不擔心了，今天學到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Learned, the case waits by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɜrnd ðə keɪs weɪts baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 學到的是，筷子盒要留在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Waits by the door tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight, beside the little cooler bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning light, the bag waits by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪt ðə bæɡ weɪts baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 晨光裡，袋子在門口等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting there since six, still cool.
dialogue.zh: 從六點就在那兒，摸起來還涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six, still cool, good sign today.
dialogue.zh: 六點，還涼著，今天有好兆頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good sign, the ice packs stay hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd saɪn ðə aɪs pæks steɪ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 好兆頭，保冷劑還是硬硬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hard packs, dry box, clean lid.
dialogue.zh: 保冷劑硬、盒子乾、蓋子乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean lid, closed with one light click.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin lɪd kloʊzd wɪð wʌn laɪt klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 蓋子乾淨，輕輕一聲就扣上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click sound, then we check his name tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk saʊnd ðɛn wi tʃɛk hɪz neɪm tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 一聲輕響，接著檢查他的姓名吊牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name tag on, water bottle full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Full bottle, cap turned tight twice.
dialogue.zh: 水裝滿，瓶蓋再轉緊兩圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight cap, no wet homework inside.
dialogue.zh: 瓶蓋鎖緊，書包裡不會溼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside the bag, his lunch box rests.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bæɡ hɪz lʌntʃ bɑks rɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 袋子裡面，他的便當盒安安穩穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rests flat, on top of the thin towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛsts flæt ɑn tɑp ʌv ðə θɪn ˈtaʊəl/
dialogue.zh: 平平地放著，壓在薄毛巾上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That towel did real work today.
dialogue.zh: 那條毛巾今天真的派上用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real work, zero bruises on the fruit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril wɜrk ˈzɪroʊ ˈbruzɪz ɑn ðə frut/
dialogue.zh: 真的有效，水果一顆都沒有撞傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit whole, and the eggs sliced neat.
dialogue.phonetic: /frut hoʊl ænd ði ɛɡz slaɪst nit/
dialogue.zh: 水果完整，蛋也切得整整齊齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neat slices, that is his style.
dialogue.zh: 切片整齊，那就是他的風格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Style packed, now off to the bus stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /staɪl pækt naʊ ɔf tə ðə bʌs stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 造型收好了，現在前往公車站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bus stop, seven minutes past six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Past six, and he still boards it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst sɪks ænd hi stɪl bɔrdz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 六點過，他還是趕上了車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boards it, bag swinging behind him.
dialogue.zh: 上車了，袋子在身後一晃一晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swinging bag, full of our morning work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswɪŋɪŋ bæɡ fʊl ʌv ˈaʊɚ ˈmɔrnɪŋ wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 晃著的袋子，裝滿我們一早的功夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning work, plus the folded note.
dialogue.zh: 一早的功夫，還有那張摺好的紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Note folded small, under the carrot flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊt ˈfoʊldɪd smɔl ˈʌndɚ ðə ˈkærət ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 紙條摺小，塞在胡蘿蔔花下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Carrot flowers, cut with the tiny knife.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkærət ˈflaʊɚz kʌt wɪð ðə ˈtaɪni naɪf/
dialogue.zh: 胡蘿蔔花，用小刀一片片切出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny knife, big patience needed there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Patience paid off, and he talked tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪʃəns peɪd ɔf ænd hi tɔkt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 耐心有了回報，他今晚主動說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He talked? what did he say exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /hi tɔkt wʌt dɪd hi seɪ ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 他說了？他到底講了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He said, best lunch box ever.
dialogue.zh: 他說，這是最好吃的便當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those words, from his own mouth.
dialogue.zh: 那幾個字，是他自己親口說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His own mouth, loud at the lunch table.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz oʊn maʊθ laʊd æt ðə lʌntʃ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 他親口說的，在午餐桌上大聲說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loud at lunch? did the teacher hear?
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd æt lʌntʃ dɪd ðə ˈtitʃɚ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 午餐時大聲說？老師聽見了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Teacher heard, and came over to look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtitʃɚ hɜrd ænd keɪm ˈoʊvɚ tə lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 老師聽見了，還走過來看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Looked at the rice balls, smiled at the egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊkt æt ðə raɪs bɔlz smaɪld æt ði ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 看了看飯糰，又看看那顆蛋，笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smiled most at the carrot flowers.
dialogue.zh: 笑得最開心的，還是那些胡蘿蔔花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Carrot flowers were the big hit?
dialogue.zh: 胡蘿蔔花才是最大亮點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big hit, three friends asked for one.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ hɪt θri frɛndz æskt fɚ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 大受歡迎，三個朋友都想要一片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For one rice ball, fair trade then.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ wʌn raɪs bɔl fɛr treɪd ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 換一片？那算公平的交換。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, he said, grinning across the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr hi sɛd ˈɡrɪnɪŋ əˈkrɔs ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 他隔著桌子咧嘴笑，說很公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grinning, and did he share the fruit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡrɪnɪŋ ænd dɪd hi ʃɛr ðə frut/
dialogue.zh: 咧嘴笑的他，有沒有分水果？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He shared two apple slices with Leo.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ʃɛrd tu ˈæpəl ˈslaɪsɪz wɪð ˈlio/
dialogue.zh: 他分了兩片蘋果給裡奧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With Leo, did he taste the egg?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ˈlio dɪd hi teɪst ði ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 跟裡奧一起，他有嚐到蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He tasted one, then asked for carrot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈtæstɪd wʌn ðɛn æskt fɚ ˈkærət/
dialogue.zh: 他嚐了一口，接著多要胡蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra carrot, the flower shape again.
dialogue.zh: 多要的胡蘿蔔，又是花的形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flower shapes made him famous today.
dialogue.zh: 花的形狀，讓他今天出了名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Famous? just from one cheap carrot.
dialogue.zh: 出名？竟然只靠一根胡蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cheap carrot, and our small note.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tʃip ˈkærət ænd ˈaʊɚ smɔl noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 一根便宜的胡蘿蔔，還有我們的小紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our small note, did he read it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ smɔl noʊt dɪd hi rid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們的小紙條，他有看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it twice, out loud, at lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt twaɪs aʊt laʊd æt lʌntʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out loud? in that noisy lunch room.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt laʊd ɪn ðæt ˈnɔɪzi lʌntʃ rum/
dialogue.zh: 大聲讀？在那鬧哄哄的午餐教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noisy room, three friends leaned closer.
dialogue.zh: 教室再吵，三個朋友都湊近聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closer, to see the apple slices.
dialogue.zh: 湊近一點，是想看蘋果片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slices thin, bright, not brown at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslaɪsɪz θɪn braɪt nɑt braʊn æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 蘋果片薄又亮，完全沒有變色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not brown, what stopped that this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt braʊn wʌt stɑpt ðæt ðɪs taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 沒變色，這次是什麼擋住的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt water, two minutes, then dried.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes bought a clean bright box.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts bɔt ə klin braɪt bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，換來一個乾淨明亮的盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright box, only tiny crumbs came home.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt bɑks ˈoʊnli ˈtaɪni krʌmz keɪm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 明亮的盒子，回家時只剩一點碎屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crumbs mean he truly ate today.
dialogue.zh: 有碎屑，代表他今天真的吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truly ate, and slowly too.
dialogue.zh: 真的吃了，而且吃得不急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly, because the rice stayed soft.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢地吃，因為飯糰還是軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft rice, the cold packs did their job.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft raɪs ðə koʊld pæks dɪd ðɛr dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 飯還軟，保冷劑盡了本分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their job, keeping everything cool.
dialogue.zh: 它們的任務，就是讓一切保持涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool till noon, even the cucumber pieces.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul tɪl nun ˈivən ðə ˈkjumˌʌmbɚ ˈpisɪz/
dialogue.zh: 涼到中午，連小黃瓜片也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cucumber crunch came from one fridge hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkjumˌʌmbɚ krʌntʃ keɪm frəm wʌn frɪdʒ ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 小黃瓜那口脆，是冰箱一小時換來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fridge hour, worth every minute.
dialogue.zh: 冰一小時，每一分鐘都值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth it, and the egg half?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Egg half vanished first, yolk still soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡ hæf ˈvænɪʃt fɜrst joʊk stɪl sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 半顆蛋最先消失，蛋黃還嫩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft yolk, his favorite part today.
dialogue.zh: 嫩蛋黃，是他今天最愛的一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Favorite part, he named it twice.
dialogue.zh: 最愛的那一口，他講了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice, and the teacher cookie trade?
dialogue.zh: 講兩次，還有老師那塊餅乾的交換？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cookie for one rice ball, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈkʊki fɚ wʌn raɪs bɔl dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一塊餅乾換一個飯糰，成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, so our rice balls travel far.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn soʊ ˈaʊɚ raɪs bɔlz ˈtrævəl fɑr/
dialogue.zh: 成交，我們的飯糰因此走得很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Travel far, and one more mom asked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrævəl fɑr ænd wʌn mɔr mɑm æskt/
dialogue.zh: 走很遠，還有一位媽媽也開口問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Asked what, about our carrot method?
dialogue.zh: 問什麼？是我們切胡蘿蔔的方法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She wants it written for her own box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɑnts ɪt ˈrɪtən fɚ hɜr oʊn bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 她想請我們寫下來，給她自己的便當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Written down, on that little paper card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪtən daʊn ɑn ðæt ˈlɪtəl ˈpeɪpɚ kɑrd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper card tonight, tomorrow two boxes.
dialogue.zh: 紙卡今晚寫，明天就備兩盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two boxes, one packed for Leo?
dialogue.zh: 兩盒，其中一盒裝給裡奧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For Leo, plain rice, he had none.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ ˈlio pleɪn raɪs hi hæd nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 給裡奧的那盒只有白飯，他本來就沒有便當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Had none? Then he gets a small note.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæd nʌn ðɛn hi ɡɛts ə smɔl noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 沒有便當？那他也要有一張小紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small note, pencil kept dry again.
dialogue.zh: 小紙條，鉛筆字這次要保持乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kept dry, the eggs are cooling now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kept draɪ ði ɛɡz ɑr ˈkulɪŋ naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooling fast, ready before eight tonight.
dialogue.zh: 涼得很快，今晚八點前就能就緒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before eight, we slice the apples.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slice them thin, cut grapes in halves.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪs ðɛm θɪn kʌt ɡreɪps ɪn hævz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In halves, never whole, safety first.
dialogue.zh: 對半切，絕不整顆，安全第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safety first, then a dry napkin.
dialogue.zh: 安全第一，再來是一張乾餐巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry napkin folded under the lid.
dialogue.zh: 乾餐巾摺好，墊在蓋子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the lid, everything fits flat.
dialogue.zh: 蓋子下面，什麼都平平放好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fits flat, the bag zips in one pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪts flæt ðə bæɡ zɪps ɪn wʌn pʊl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pull done, that is the whole trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pʊl dʌn ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 一拉就好，這就是全部的訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whole trick learned by both of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl trɪk lɜrnd baɪ boʊθ ʌv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 這訣竅，我們兩個都學會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both of us, and him tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Him too, he packs his own egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪm tu hi pæks hɪz oʊn ɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 也算他，他自己放一顆蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His own egg, done before the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz oʊn ɛɡ dʌn bɪˈfɔr ðə bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 他自己那顆蛋，上巴士前就完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the bus, the box goes inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə bʌs ðə bɑks ɡoʊz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 上巴士前，盒子放進袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goes inside, right beside the red case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊz ɪnˈsaɪd raɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə rɛd keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 放進去，就擺在紅色筷子盒旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beside the case, nothing gets forgotten.
dialogue.zh: 在筷子盒旁，這回什麼都不會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing forgotten, that is the best part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ fɚˈɡɑtən ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒忘，這才是最棒的一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Best part, tomorrow we begin again.
dialogue.zh: 最棒的，是明天還能重新開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tonight, lights low, box by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn təˈnaɪt laɪts loʊ bɑks baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那就今晚，燈調暗，盒子在門口就位。
